fr.excerpt: Annuellement, une journée est dédiée aux droits des femmes (le 8 mars). Une autre, permet de mettre en lumière la participation des femmes et des filles dans le domaine des sciences (le 11 février).

blocks.html:
Annuellement, une journée est dédiée aux droits des femmes (le 8 mars). Une autre, permet de mettre en lumière la participation des femmes et des filles dans le domaine des sciences (le 11 février). Cependant, chaque jour, les femmes et les filles se démarquent, se dépassent, s’imposent au cœur de cette discipline qui devient peu à peu leur mode de vie.

Pour ma part, ce choix de carrière ne s’est pas présenté comme le premier. J’avais une facilité naturelle pour les arts et les lettres. Toutes les occasions étaient bonnes pour rédiger et m’exprimer à travers les mots. Cependant, une chose m’habitait, celle de vouloir changer le monde, apporter mes talents au bénéfice de mes semblables. Comme j’étais réservée et timide, je m’imaginais difficilement travailler auprès des gens. C’est alors que l’illumination s’est manifestée, j’allais aider mon prochain, mais à l’arrière-scène, en laboratoire. Dès les premiers cours de science, j'étais fascinée par cette merveilleuse machine qu’est le corps humain et ses systèmes parfaitement rythmés et coordonnés. 

En secondaire 3, j’avais fait un exposé oral qui portait sur le sang. Dans mes recherches préparatoires, j’avais pris conscience de la composition de ce produit sanguin et vivant, de son rôle, de ses pathologies. Les érythrocytes (globules rouges), les leucocytes (globules blancs), les thrombocytes (plaquettes) qui baignent dans un liquide riche en protéines, appelé plasma, avaient complètement attiré mon attention. Non seulement la mienne, mais également celle de mon auditoire. Que dire quand on peut visualiser les cellules sanguines par microscopie ? La forme et la composition de chaque cellule doivent être respectées, tout comme leur nombre et leur niveau de maturité dans la circulation. C’est à ce moment que j’ai réalisé que rien n’est laissé au hasard. Tout doit vivre dans un ordre déterminé et parfait, sinon, le désordre qui se crée alors, entraîne une anomalie (anémie) et même une pathologie (hémophilie, leucémie). 

Au-delà des formations en chimie, en physique et en mathématiques, j’ai aussi eu le besoin d’étudier, de façon plus concrète, le corps humain et ses différents systèmes (digestif, circulatoire, respiratoire, reproducteur). Je me suis donc lancée dans l’étude de la biochimie, de l’hématologie, de l’hémostase, de la microbiologie et de la pathologie. Toutes ces disciplines sont aussi envoûtantes les unes que les autres. C’est ‘’le vivant’’ dans sa plus riche, belle et simple expression. 

Ces matières ont continué, au fil du temps, à me surprendre, à me fasciner et surtout à me plaire ! Leur pratique au quotidien me permettait d’apporter ma touche personnelle et humaine à des gestes minutieux et froids. 

Comme tout parcours, ce ne fût pas toujours simple et sans embûche, bien au contraire. Puisque je n’avais pas nécessairement de facilité en sciences, mes professeurs du secondaire essayaient, à l’époque, de me dissuader d’aller vers ces matières, de peur que je n’échoue. Il n’en fallait pas plus pour me lancer à pieds joints, pour leur prouver, tout en me prouvant à moi-même aussi, que j’y arriverais ! Un peu plus tard, côtoyer des enseignantes, femmes passionnées qui m’ont inspirée et transmis leur amour pour les sciences, m’a alors définitivement et assurément encouragée sur cette voie. C’est cette inspiration, amalgamée à ma curiosité, mon entêtement, mon acharnement, mon courage et mon ambition, qui m’a conduite sur le chemin de la réussite. Je suis une preuve vivante que quand on veut, on peut !

Aujourd’hui, les femmes de science continuent à innover avec fraîcheur et originalité. Elles ont un double rôle puisqu’elles œuvrent à la fois dans les sciences, mais en parallèle, elles continuent, à travers les siècles, à porter et à donner la vie. Elles permettent d’assurer, au fil du temps, une relève de futures scientifiques !

J’aimerais encourager toutes les femmes et les filles à suivre leurs rêves, à ne jamais se laisser décourager par diverses circonstances du quotidien, par les obstacles de toutes sortes, par les insuccès temporaires. D’ailleurs, l’échec n’existe pas, ce n’est qu’une occasion de plus de se surpasser, de briller. Il faut suivre sa passion. Il faut vivre sa passion. Il faut avoir une vision claire et mettre tous les efforts nécessaires pour l’atteindre. Pour me maintenir concentrée et vibrante, j’aime garder toujours à l’esprit cette phrase motivante du grand Nelson Mandela qui dit ‘’Je ne perds jamais. Soit je gagne, soit j’apprends.’’

en.meta_description: The Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) brings new safety, labeling, and compliance requirements . Learn more.
en.title: The Impact of MoCRA on Cosmetic Industry Regulations
en.excerpt: The Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) changes U.S. cosmetic rules. It aims to make cosmetics safer; companies must meet new requirements for labeling, good manufacturing practices (GMP), and reporting adverse events.
en.author_bio: Neopharm offers expert analytical services for the life sciences industry. We provide reliable GMP quality control testing and innovative R&D solutions to accelerate product development.

blocks.html:
MoCRA significantly expands the FDA's authority over cosmetic products, introducing new requirements for facility registration, product listing, adverse event reporting, and labeling. The act mandates that manufacturers adhere to strict Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and maintain records demonstrating product safety. These changes align U.S. regulations more closely with international standards, such as those in the European Union, which Canadian companies may already be familiar with.

Elements to consider in the MoCRA include:

  • Fragrance Allergen Disclosure: Cosmetic labels must list all fragrance allergens for greater consumer transparency about potential product allergens.
  • Responsible Person Information: Labels must include contact information for the Responsible Person (RP) to facilitate adverse event reporting.
  • Adverse Event Reporting: Manufacturers must report serious adverse events to the FDA within 15 business days and maintain these records for six years.
  • Mandatory Registration and Listing: Facilities and products must be registered with the FDA, ensuring all entities are on the agency's radar.
  • Exemptions for Small Businesses: MoCRA provides certain exemptions for small businesses with less than $1 million in average gross annual sales in the U.S. over the previous three years. These businesses are exempt from some requirements, such as GMP, facility registration, and product listing. However, these exemptions do not apply to products that touch the eye's mucous membrane, are meant for injection or internal use, or change the appearance for more than 24 hours and are not removed in general by the consumer.

Steps U.S. and Canadian Companies Are Taking

To comply with MoCRA, cosmetic companies operating in both the U.S. and Canada are implementing several strategies:

  • Facility and Process Upgrades: Ensuring that manufacturing facilities meet GMP standards and processes are well-documented.
  • Training and Personnel Management: Providing comprehensive training to staff to ensure compliance with new regulatory requirements.
  • Quality Assurance and Control: Implementing rigorous quality control measures and maintaining detailed records to demonstrate compliance.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Engaging with regulatory bodies to ensure all necessary licenses and approvals are in place.

Embracing Opportunities and Overcoming Challenges

While MoCRA introduces additional regulatory requirements, it also presents opportunities for cosmetic companies to streamline compliance efforts across major markets like the U.S. and the EU. By leveraging the expertise of partners like Neopharm Labs, companies can ensure their products are safe, compliant, and of high quality, positioning themselves for success in a competitive global market.

In summary, the changing regulations pose challenges and opportunities for cosmetic companies in the U.S. and Canada. Companies need to understand the impact of MoCRA and proactively adhere to new GMP requirements. Doing so will help them meet regulatory standards, enhance their reputation for quality and safety, and ultimately drive growth and success in the global cosmetics industry.

Neopharm’s Expertise in cosmetic product testing

Neopharm offers a range of services to help companies in the U.S. and Canada comply with MoCRA:

  1. GMP Quality Control Testing: Ensuring products meet safety and quality standards through reliable testing.
  2. Microbiology and Sterility Testing: Verifying product safety by testing for harmful microorganisms and contaminants.
  3. Method Development and Validation: Developing and validating analytical methods to ensure consistent and reliable testing.
Partner with Neopharm to ensure your cosmetic products are safe, effective, and compliant.

Source:

https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/registration-listing-cosmetic-product-facilities-and-products

Disclaimer: This article provides an overview of MoCRA and its implications for cosmetic companies. However, it is not exhaustive, and regulations may continue to evolve. For the most current and comprehensive information, please check the official FDA website at www.fda.gov/cosmetics

fr.meta_title: MoCRA, évolution de la réglementation cosmétique aux États-Unis
fr.meta_description: La loi sur la modernisation de la réglementation des cosmétiques (MoCRA) impose de nouvelles exigences. En savoir plus.
fr.title: L'impact du MoCRA sur la réglementation de l'industrie cosmétique
fr.excerpt: La Modernisation of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) modifie les règles américaines sur les cosmétiques. Il vise à rendre les cosmétiques plus sûrs ; les entreprises doivent satisfaire aux nouvelles exigences en matière d'étiquetage, de bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) entre autres.
fr.author_bio: Neopharm offre des services analytiques experts pour l'industrie des sciences de la vie. Nous fournissons des tests de contrôle qualité GMP fiables et des solutions de R&D innovantes.

blocks.html:
Le MoCRA élargit considérablement l'autorité de la FDA sur les produits cosmétiques, en introduisant de nouvelles exigences pour l'enregistrement des installations, la liste des produits, la déclaration des événements indésirables et l'étiquetage. La loi exige que les fabricants adhèrent à des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) strictes et tiennent des registres démontrant l'innocuité des produits. Ces changements harmonisent plus étroitement la réglementation américaine avec les normes internationales, comme celles de l'Union européenne, que les entreprises canadiennes connaissent peut-être déjà.

Les éléments à prendre en compte dans le MoCRA comprennent

  • Divulgation des allergènes de parfums : Les étiquettes des cosmétiques doivent énumérer tous les allergènes de parfums pour une plus grande transparence des consommateurs au sujet des allergènes potentiels des produits.
  • Renseignements sur la personne responsable : Les étiquettes doivent comprendre les coordonnées de la personne responsable (PR) afin de faciliter la déclaration des événements indésirables.
  • Déclaration des événements indésirables : Les fabricants doivent signaler les événements indésirables graves à la FDA dans les 15 jours ouvrables et tenir ces registres pendant six ans.
  • Enregistrement et inscription obligatoires : Les installations et les produits doivent être enregistrés auprès de la FDA, en veillant à ce que toutes les entités soient sur le radar de l'agence.
  • Exemptions pour les petites entreprises : Le MoCRA prévoit certaines exemptions pour les petites entreprises dont les ventes annuelles brutes moyennes aux États-Unis sont inférieures à 1 million de dollars au cours des trois années précédentes. Ces entreprises sont exemptées de certaines exigences, telles que les BPF, l'enregistrement des installations et la liste des produits. Cependant, ces exemptions ne s'appliquent pas aux produits qui touchent la membrane muqueuse de l'œil, qui sont destinés à l'injection ou à un usage interne, ou qui modifient l'apparence pendant plus de 24 heures et qui ne sont pas retirés en général par le consommateur.

Mesures prises par les entreprises américaines et canadiennes

Pour se conformer au MoCRA, les entreprises de cosmétiques opérant aux États-Unis et au Canada mettent en œuvre plusieurs stratégies :

  • Mises à niveau des installations et des processus : S'assurer que les installations de fabrication respectent les normes et les processus de BPF sont bien documentés.
  • Formation et gestion du personnel : Offrir une formation complète au personnel pour assurer la conformité aux nouvelles exigences réglementaires.
  • Assurance et contrôle de la qualité : Mettre en œuvre des mesures rigoureuses de contrôle de la qualité et tenir des dossiers détaillés pour démontrer la conformité.
  • Conformité réglementaire : Collaborer avec les organismes de réglementation pour s'assurer que toutes les licences et approbations nécessaires sont en place.

Saisir les occasions et surmonter les défis

Bien que le MoCRA introduise des exigences réglementaires supplémentaires, il présente également des opportunités pour les entreprises de cosmétiques de rationaliser les efforts de conformité sur les principaux marchés comme les États-Unis et l'UE. En tirant parti de l'expertise de partenaires comme Neopharm Labs, les entreprises peuvent s'assurer que leurs produits sont sûrs, conformes et de haute qualité, se positionnant pour réussir sur un marché mondial concurrentiel.

En résumé, l'évolution de la réglementation pose des défis et des opportunités pour les entreprises de cosmétiques aux États-Unis et au Canada. Les entreprises doivent comprendre l'impact du MoCRA et adhérer de manière proactive aux nouvelles exigences en matière de BPF. Cela les aidera à respecter les normes réglementaires, à améliorer leur réputation en matière de qualité et de sécurité et, en fin de compte, à stimuler la croissance et le succès dans l'industrie mondiale des cosmétiques.

L'expertise de Neopharm dans les tests de produits cosmétiques

Neopharm offre une gamme de services pour aider les entreprises aux États-Unis et au Canada à se conformer au MoCRA :

  1. Tests de contrôle de la qualité BPF : S'assurer que les produits répondent aux normes de sécurité et de qualité grâce à des tests fiables.
  2. Tests de microbiologie et de stérilité : Vérifier l'innocuité du produit par des tests pour les micro-organismes nocifs et les contaminants.
  3. Élaboration et validation de méthodes : Élaboration et validation de méthodes d'analyse pour assurer des essais uniformes et fiables.
Faites équipe avec Neopharm pour garantir que vos produits cosmétiques sont sûrs, efficaces et conformes.

Source:

https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/registration-listing-cosmetic-product-facilities-and-products

Pour les informations les plus actuelles et les plus complètes, veuillez consulter le site officiel de la FDA à www.fda.gov/cosmetics

en.title: Virtual Audits: What do we offer?
en.excerpt: COVID-19 presented some unique challenges that prompted us to re-examine the ways we work, including the way we conduct our audits.
en.author_bio: Neopharm offers expert analytical services for the life sciences industry. We provide reliable GMP quality control testing and innovative R&D solutions to accelerate product development.

blocks.html:
COVID-19 presented some unique challenges that prompted us to re-examine the ways we work, including the way we conduct our audits. In this unique new COVID environment, we had to think creatively about how to handle this process effectively while following the recommended guidelines and restrictions to ensure the safety of our team and clients.

One of the measures we took was to suggest virtual audits for our clients. Since 2020, about a third of all client audits at Neopharm Labs were conducted virtually.

Virtual Audits were implemented to mimic the traditional audits as much as possible. This includes:

  • Presentation of the organization and facility through a web portal
  • Live tour of the site through a web portal and Bluetooth® microphone used for SMEs.
  • Document review offered through the online portal giving auditors the ability navigate into the documentation by themselves with read-only access. A web camera is also available for when it's required to show larger documents.
  • Professionally recorded video footage with narration and subtitles is produced to present our main functional areas in more detail. These can be presented to complement the virtual tour.

In order to ensure the highest level of efficiency, we put the greatest emphasis on the audit preparation. It's crucial to understand the scope of the audit and to schedule the participation of the subject matter experts ahead of time in order to ensure that we have the right people in attendance. When faced with the challenge with multiple time zones, we need to remain flexible and adapt the schedules accordingly. During the audit, the host is always available to answer questions and address any issues that may arise.

Now that we've adapted to virtual audits, we see them being in use for the foreseeable future as a great way to save time, travel, and resources. The current situation has established that virtual settings can be a sustainable method of performing quality audits. The feedback we've received from clients is highly positive, so we see this as a great opportunity to continue leveraging the efficiency of them for the benefit of all parties. Now that we've proven our ability to adapt to new ways of working and meeting our client's needs, there's no doubt that virtual audits are here to stay.

La COVID-19 a présenté des défis uniques qui nous ont incités à réexaminer notre façon de travailler, y compris la façon dont nous menons nos audits. Dans ce nouveau contexte particulier de COVID, nous avons dû réfléchir de manière créative à comment gérer efficacement ce processus, tout en suivant les directives et les restrictions recommandées pour assurer la sécurité de notre équipe et de nos clients.

L'une des mesures que nous avons prises a été de proposer des audits virtuels pour nos clients. Depuis 2020, environ un tiers de tous les audits clients de Neopharm Labs ont été faits virtuellement.

Ces audits virtuels ont été mis en place de façon à se rapprocher le plus possible des audits traditionnels. Ceci comprend :

  • La présentation de l'organisation et des installations via un portail web.
  • La visite en direct du site via un portail web et un microphone Bluetooth® utilisé par les experts.
  • La revue de documents offerte via le portail en ligne, permettant aux auditeurs de naviguer seuls dans la documentation avec un accès en lecture seule. Une caméra web est également disponible lorsqu'il est nécessaire d'afficher des documents plus volumineux.
  • Des vidéos enregistrées professionnellement avec de la narration et des sous-titres, qui sont produites pour présenter nos principaux domaines fonctionnels plus en détail. Celles-ci peuvent être présentées en complément de la visite virtuelle.

Afin d'assurer le plus haut niveau d'efficacité, nous accordons une place prépondérante à la préparation de l'audit. Il est essentiel de comprendre la portée de l'audit et de planifier à l'avance l'horaire des interventions des experts en la matière afin de nous assurer que les bonnes personnes sont présentes. Quand nous sommes confrontés au défi des différents fuseaux horaires, nous devons rester flexibles et adapter le calendrier en conséquence. Au cours de l'audit, l'organisateur est toujours disponible pour répondre aux questions et s'occuper des enjeux qui pourraient surgir.

Maintenant que nous nous sommes adaptés aux audits virtuels, nous voyons comment ils pourraient être utilisés dans un avenir proche comme un excellent moyen d'économiser du temps, des déplacements et des ressources. La situation actuelle a établi que les environnements virtuels sont une méthode durable pour effectuer des audits de qualité. La rétroaction que nous avons reçue de nos clients étant très positive, nous prévoyons donc continuer à tirer profit de leur efficacité qui profite à toutes les parties concernées. Puisque nous avons prouvé notre capacité à nous adapter à ces nouvelles méthodes de travail et à répondre aux besoins de nos clients, il ne fait aucun doute que les audits virtuels sont là pour de bon.

fr.meta_description: Obtenez des informations sur la sécurité pharmaceutique grâce à notre guide sur les études d’impuretés dans le développement de médicaments.
fr.title: Un guide complet des études sur les impuretés dans le développement de médicaments.
fr.intro: Une exploration détaillée des études sur les impuretés, soulignant leur importance pour préserver le bien-être des patients et maintenir la qualité des produits.
fr.body:
Dans le domaine du développement pharmaceutique, les études sur les impuretés jouent un rôle central pour garantir la sécurité et l’efficacité des médicaments. Selon les lignes directrices Q3A et Q3B du Conseil international pour l'harmonisation des exigences techniques relatives aux produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain (ICH), les impuretés contenues dans les substances médicamenteuses sont définies comme des « substances contenues dans l'IPA qui ne sont pas l'IPA lui-même » et dans les produits pharmaceutiques comme des « substances contenues dans le produit qui n'est pas l'API lui-même ou les excipients utilisés pour le fabriquer.

Les points saillants comprennent :

  • Comprendre les différents types et sources d'impuretés dans les produits pharmaceutiques.
  • Explorer les directives réglementaires et les normes de conformité pour le contrôle des impuretés.
  • Mesures et stratégies proactives pour la détection précoce et l’atténuation des impuretés.

en.title: A Complete Guide to Impurity Studies in Drug Development.
en.intro:
Ensuring Pharmaceutical Product Safety.
A detailed exploration of impurity studies, highlighting their significance in safeguarding patient well-being and maintaining product quality.
en.body:
In the realm of pharmaceutical development, impurity studies play a pivotal role in ensuring the safety and efficacy of drugs. According to the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) guidelines Q3A and Q3B, impurities in drug substances are defined as "substances in the API that are not the API itself" and in drug products as "substances in the product that are not the API itself or the excipients used to manufacture it."

Key highlights include:

  • Understanding the different types and sources of impurities in pharmaceuticals.
  • Exploring regulatory guidelines and compliance standards for impurity control.
  • Proactive measures and strategies for early detection and mitigation of impurities.

fr.form_title: A Rapid Experimental Polar Surface Area (EPSA) Assay
fr.body:
Understanding Drug Bioavailability with Polar Surface Area

Polar surface area, often synonymous with hydrogen bond availability, stands as a pivotal physical property in comprehending drug bioavailability. Traditionally, a molecule's Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA) serves as a proxy for this property, aiding in the ranking of similar molecules. However, TPSA sometimes falls short in distinguishing compounds undergoing conformational changes in solution.

en.meta_description: Discover EPSA Assay's impact on peptide permeability. Join Neopharm's webinar for SFC techniques, best practices, and industry success stories.
en.title: EPSA Assay 101
en.intro: In this webinar on-demand, Gilles Goetz, Ph.D., an original developer of EPSA, presents the background and preliminary implementation. We hear from professionals in the industry about their own experiences using EPSA through a panel discussion and Q+A session.
en.body: EPSA is a supercritical fluid chromatography (SFC) technique for peptides that enables improved permeability design and can be used as a permeability surrogate. This method is used to assess polarity by retention time using controlled SFC conditions in a standardized method.

presenters.name: Gilles Goetz
presenters.bio: Co-developer of the EPSA Assay, Gilles presents the background of EPSA and weighs in on how it is being implemented today.

presenters.name: Bill Farrell
presenters.bio: Co-developer of the EPSA Assay, Bill discusses the assay's new niche for large molecules and peptides alongside its original use for small molecules. Bill is the moderator of this event and weighs in during the Q+A session.

presenters.name: Romulo Romero
presenters.bio: Romulo is an analytical chemist with over 20 years in pharma discovery, currently focusing on SFC, with an interest in automation and high throughput processes, as well as space exploration.

presenters.name: Huy Nguyen
presenters.bio: Huy is a scientist in the Analytical Research group from Genentech. His group focuses on running phys chem assays like EPSA, logD, and solubility. In addition, Huy's group utilizes microfluidics to develop novel phys chem assays.

presenters.name: Johan Nicolaï
presenters.role: Sr. Research Scientist Investigative ADME, UCB
presenters.bio: Johan is a senior scientist in the DMPK department at UCB. After obtaining his PhD, he joined UCB in 2016 and focused on the prediction of brain disposition of small molecules before moving to the area of intestinal drug absorption of NCEs. More recently he has been involved in the evaluation of the permeability of bRo5 compounds and is looking at ways to relate bRo5 compounds’ passive permeability to physicochemical parameters such as EPSA.

presenters.name: Erin Jordan
presenters.bio: Erin received her bachelor's degree from the University of MN and her master's in chemistry from Northwestern University, performing synthetic organic chemistry under the advisory of Karl Scheidt. Erin began her career at Abbott Laboratories in 2009 providing chiral purification support to Process Chemistry. In 2011 she transitioned into Abbott/AbbVie Drug Discovery where she currently co-leads the chiral SFC platform supporting medicinal chemistry therapeutic teams.  Erin has been running the EPSA assay within her group since 2018.

presenters.name: Paul Lefebvre
presenters.bio: General Manager of Neopharm Boston, former Averica Discovery, since 2018, Paul has worked in separations and purification for over 25 years. His experience with purification has been as both a vendor and a customer.

en.bio:

With a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the University of Buenos Aires, Argentina, and a Ph.D. in Biochemistry from the University of Notre Dame, USA, he has conducted postdoctoral research at the Lady Davis Institute, McGill University, Canada.

Throughout his career, Jorge has focused on researching properties of aqueous solutions at extreme conditions and delved into coagulation, inflammation, and vascular biology in blood. His experience has been instrumental in various R&D projects within the biotech industry and clinical diagnostics, including the development of medical devices and assays for quality control evaluations and companion diagnostics for patient care.

Driven by a passion for learning and innovation, Jorge is dedicated to advancing the biotechnology and pharmaceutical sectors at Neopharm's Life Sciences Lab. He plays a pivotal role in supporting the development and quality control of the latest generation of therapeutic products, including biologicals, genes, and cell therapies, ensuring Neopharm continues to be at the forefront of cutting-edge healthcare solutions.

Son expérience a été essentielle pour divers projets de R&D dans l’industrie biotechnologique et les diagnostics cliniques, notamment le développement de dispositifs médicaux et de tests pour l’évaluation du contrôle qualité et les diagnostics associés aux soins des patients.

en.lead: Meet Martin, a highly skilled professional with expertise in pharmaceuticals, microbiology, and strategic planning. Martin's skills ensure top-notch quality for Neopharm's clients.
en.bio:
With over 19 years of experience in contract laboratory management, Martin has a remarkable career that includes 11 years in the pharmaceutical sector, seven years in research and development, and an additional two years in the food industry. 
He has expertise in quality control for both raw materials and finished products, including sterile and non-sterile ones. He's also experienced in developing and validating methods for finished products, validating disinfectants, and rigorously validating laboratory equipment. His profound knowledge of analytical microbiology enables him to effectively meet the evolving demands of the industry's diverse clientele.

Martin has been the driving force behind teams entrusted with conducting routine GMP analyses and crafting essential methods for routine testing. He's adept at evaluating and implementing rapid analysis methods and cutting-edge equipment, particularly in the pharmaceutical and food sectors, with an emphasis on the automation of antibiotic and microbial identification tests. Additionally, Martin has played a pivotal role in the establishment and execution of stringent cleanroom validation processes.

Martin has a Doctorate in Microbiology with a specialization in the ecophysiology of microscopic fungi from McGill University. He also holds a Master's degree in Environmental Science, which focused on the isolation, purification, and evaluation of entomopathogenic fungi from the University of Quebec at Trois-Rivières. Furthermore, he earned a Bachelor's degree in Biological Science from the University of Quebec in Rimouski.

Martin's remarcable academic background, rich experience, and unwavering dedication position him as a leading authority in contract laboratory management. He continues to be a driving force in delivering exceptional results to clients in the pharmaceutical and food industries.

Throughout her career, Mylène has showcased her mastery of a wide range of analyses, including antibiotic assays, sterile room sterility tests, Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing, and routine micro limit tests. 

With a relentless focus on delivering results and exceptional client service, Mylène has broadened her expertise within the Quality department, where she has been thriving for the past 6 years. Her profound understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and her proficiency in enhancing quality processes have been pivotal to Neopharm's success.

Thami's unwavering commitment to analytical skills and the pursuit of R&D excellence rapidly propelled him into roles of greater responsibility. Throughout his career, Thami has consistently demonstrated mastery of science, analysis, risk assessment, quality assurance, and project management. His commitment to staff development and strategic planning has been crucial in driving the success of his teams and projects. He has cultivated high-performing teams that deliver excellent customer satisfaction to Neopharm's clientele.

Thami is a highly skilled and forward-thinking professional who consistently drives innovation and excellence in the pharmaceutical industry. His dedication to research and development, and his strategic planning skills, make him an invaluable asset to Neopharm and the industry.

en.name: Yvan Côté
en.lead: Yvan is an accomplished senior executive with a track record of building transformational business success in the diagnostic and pharmaceutical industry since 1992.
en.bio:
Yvan joined Neopharm Labs in July 2021 following his most recent role as Director General of Dynacare Genetics and Specialty Service. During that time, Yvan was awarded the LabCorp Chairman Award in 2015 for his work in the areas of scientific leadership, customer focus, and for being the primary driver in building leading national laboratory testing business. Most recently, he was also selected for the Hero Award to recognize his extraordinary performance in support of the Covid-19 response.

Previous to Dynacare, Yvan was VP, Research & Development and General Manager of Warnex for eight years and also led the R&D department at Biochem for seven years before.

Yvan holds a Ph.D. in Biotechnology from the University of Sherbrooke, and has extensive industry knowledge around topics of life sciences, clinical development, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, infectious diseases as well as microbiology and immunology.

We are excited to have Yvan as President and General Director as he leads the Neopharm Labs, and our sister Company Averica Discovery, into the future with success.

If Yvan is ever out of his office, he is most likely at David’s Teas choosing his next flavour of his favourite hot beverage.

Avant de rejoindre Dynacare, Yvan a été vice-président, recherche et développement, et directeur général de Warnex pendant huit ans. Il a également dirigé le département de R&D de Biochem pendant sept ans.

Yvan est titulaire d'un doctorat en biotechnologie de l'Université de Sherbrooke et possède une connaissance approfondie de l'industrie dans les domaines des sciences de la vie, du développement clinique, des dispositifs médicaux, des produits pharmaceutiques, des maladies infectieuses ainsi que de la microbiologie et de l'immunologie.

en.title: Metrology specialist

sections.title: About the Position
sections.html:
The use of the masculine gender has been adopted to facilitate reading and is not intended to be discriminatory.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A METROLOGY SPECIALIST

For over 30 years, Neopharm Labs has played a vital role in the development of health products through its expertise in research and development, analytical testing, scientific analysis, and regulatory compliance. We are recognized for our commitment to industry best practices and compliance with national and international regulations.

Neopharm provides analytical services to manufacturers of pharmaceuticals, natural health products, and cosmetics. Our continuously updated quality systems ensure fast, reliable, and compliant results that meet the highest standards in both domestic and international markets.

Our Mission

To support life sciences companies — whether emerging or established — in their pursuit of medical innovation, with an approach based on:

  • Rigor
  • Transparency
  • Flexibility
  • Reliability

Join a growing Canadian leader in the life sciences industry.

Job description 

The Metrology Specialist is responsible for the maintenance, calibration, repair, and qualification of laboratory equipment, as well as the overall management of all instruments in compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

The incumbent develops, reviews, and executes Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols for instruments and equipment. They are also responsible for maintaining inventory and tracking specific events related to each piece of equipment in the asset management software (CMMS).

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive maintenance, repairs, adjustments, calibration, and validation of all laboratory instruments and equipment as required, following manufacturer-recommended procedures or those established by Neopharm.
  • Install and qualify new laboratory instruments (IQ/OQ/PQ) in compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Record calibration, validation, maintenance, and repair results in reports or appendices within equipment logs.
  • Monitor daily operations of systems related to laboratory activities.
  • Organize and manage external calibration of primary instruments and liaise with external service providers as needed.
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of equipment and qualification dates in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Keep an inventory of spare parts for critical equipment to minimize downtime in case of failure.
  • Document any non-conformity, deviation, incident, or malfunction in the quality system and notify the relevant manager(s).
  • Assist laboratory personnel with the use and maintenance of instruments and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Write and revise SOPs related to instrumentation.
  • Perform other related tasks as mutually agreed upon and assigned by the immediate supervisor
     

Profile Sought

  • Bachelor’s degree or college diploma in sciences (Chemistry or Biology) or in Electronics (with relevant experience).
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in laboratory instrumental analysis (an asset).
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (GMP).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, strong organizational abilities, and meticulous documentation practices.
  • Experience in instrumentation and analytical chemistry is a definite asset.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a structured, regulated environment.
  • French (spoken) – English (reading and writing).
     

Why Join Neopharm?

  • A growing Canadian company in the life sciences sector
  • A stimulating environment focused on innovation and excellence
  • High-impact projects with globally recognized partners
  • A corporate culture built on quality, collaboration, and respect
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Dynamic and fast-paced environment that keeps you informed of the latest industry trends
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including group insurance, employer-contributed retirement plan, and other attractive perks
  • Employee Assistance Program and telemedicine services
  • Public transportation costs reimbursed by the company

Are you ready to contribute to the life sciences industry and help improve global health?

Join Neopharm Labs, a trusted partner of leading organizations in the sector.

 

*Please note that your resume will be shared with the hiring manager. We thank you for your interest in Neopharm Labs Inc., but only selected candidates will be contacted.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES SPECIALIST - QPIC/AQPIC

For over 30 years, Neopharm Labs has played a key role in the development of health products through its expertise in research and development, analytical testing, scientific analysis, and regulatory compliance. We are recognized for our commitment to industry best practices and our adherence to national and international regulations.

Neopharm provides analytical services to manufacturers of pharmaceutical products, natural health products, and cosmetics. Our continuously updated quality systems ensure fast, reliable, and compliant results that meet the highest standards in domestic and international markets.

Our Mission

To support life sciences companies whether emerging or established in their pursuit of medical innovation, through an approach grounded in:

  • rigor
  • transparency
  • flexibility
  • reliability

Main Responsibilities

  • Perform inventory of Controlled Substances regulated under applicable laws and procedures, according to required frequencies.
  • Supervise and coordinate the work of AQPIC personnel.
  • Oversee the receipt of Controlled Substances and ensure they are inspected according to Health Canada requirements, including identification, product and container weighing, and density calculations.
  • Grant access to authorized personnel requiring entry to stability chambers located in the vault (e.g., maintenance, sample additions or removals).
  • Complete, sign, photocopy, and follow up on client requisitions.
  • Maintain and update SOPs related to regulated Controlled Substances.
  • Anticipate and request USP standards for Controlled Substances as needed.
  • Be available on call during weekends and nights for stability chamber excursions related to Controlled Substances.
  • Prepare monthly receipt reports and submit them to Health Canada.
  • Act as the primary resource for communications with Health Canada regarding questions or audits related to regulated Controlled Substances.
  • Create transfer requisitions and import permit request forms for Health Canada, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Ensure the creation and follow-up of documentation related to waste management providers handling controlled residual materials.
  • Manage and authorize archive destruction according to established procedures.
  • Oversee license renewals and license modification notifications for regulated Controlled Substances.
  • Perform any other related tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor or required based on operational needs.

Desired Profile:

  • QPIC or AQPIC designation required.
  • Integrity
  • Autonomy
  • Strong observational skills
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Membership in the Order of Chemists (an asset)
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical laboratory
  • Experience as PQR or PQRS (an asset)
  • College diploma in a science field qualifying the candidate to be designated as PQR/PQRS or PR
  • Bilingual (English and French)

blocks.title_html: Our commitment is to transform our clients' visions into reality.
blocks.text_html:
At Neopharm our team of experts, equipped with cutting-edge technology and unwavering dedication, work tirelessly to transform our clients' visions into reality. As trusted partners to leaders in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry, we're driven by a passion to improve the lives of the global community.

blocks.label: Our History

Founded in 1990, with extensive combined expertise across our businesses, we provide solutions for every stage of product development and commercialization.  Our reach and services expanded through the acquisitions of Averica Discovery (USA) and MS Pharma, and the launch of our Life Sciences Division. Integrated as one entity allows us to better support our partners in the pharmaceutical industry.

Committed to the analytical needs of our clients, we strive to provide reliable, cost-effective, and innovative solutions.

At Neopharm, we pride ourselves on delivering reliable, cost-effective, and innovative solutions to our clients. Our team of experts, equipped with diverse scientific backgrounds and technical proficiencies, excels in tackling complex challenges with precision and efficiency. We believe that our clients' success is the ultimate measure of our own, and we prioritize their needs, challenges, and goals.

blocks.label: Our Purpose
blocks.html:
Mission

Join our life sciences partners to ensure the quality of their products using our proven analytical services.

Vision

We strive to be the reference in Canada in the field of analytical services for the life sciences industry. As we pursue this vision, we remain committed to maintaining our position as an employer of choice, attracting top talent, and fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Values

At Neopharm, we have set clear expectations for how we can support our clients and our talent. To achieve our purpose, we follow six powerful values that define our company and culture.

  • Customer Centric: We place our clients at the center of everything we do, providing tailored solutions that surpass expectations.
  • Quality & Reliability: We maintain a quality-focused culture and continuously improve our processes to meet regulatory standards and client expectations.
  • Expertise & Innovation: Our team's knowledge and expertise drive our innovative approach, enabling us to tackle scientific challenges with confidence.
  • Team Spirit: Collaboration and teamwork are the pillars of our success, fostering an environment of trust, support, and shared accomplishments.
  • Rigor & Commitment: We adhere to the highest standards of excellence, ensuring accuracy, precision, and dedication in all aspects of our work.
  • Well-being and Talent Development: We prioritize the well-being and professional growth of our talent, creating a positive and fulfilling work environment.

blocks.label: Our Services
blocks.html:
Neopharm boasts state-of-the-art facilities in Canada.

At Neopharm Labs, we offer a comprehensive suite of services that cover every stage of the product lifecycle. Our extensive range of analytical solutions expedites the journey from concept to commercialization. With our high throughput capacity, we can handle projects of varying scales and complexities without compromising quality or turnaround time. This enables our clients to accelerate their research and development processes, streamline operations, and bring their products to market faster.

blocks.label: Regulatory Profile
blocks.html:
Quality and Compliance

We are committed to maintaining the highest level of quality and compliance with industry standards. Our labs are equipped with cutting-edge IT infrastructure and an extensive range of upgraded equipment to ensure the highest level of testing diversity and quality. We adhere to regulatory standards, including data integrity, and we are licensed and inspected by Licensed by:

  1. Health Canada's Health Products and Food Branch Inspectorate (HPFBI)
  2. U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
  3. Controlled Drugs and Substances License permit
  4. Class A Precursor License
  5. Cannabis License
  6. Audited and qualified by many global pharmaceutical organizations

We are defined by excellence and inclusion 

With a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability and social responsibility. We contribute to medical advancements by supporting clients in the development and marketing of new treatments, including biologicals and vaccines. We embrace diversity and equal opportunities, recognizing the valuable contributions of women and employees from diverse backgrounds. We strive to minimize our environmental impact by implementing eco-friendly practices, managing laboratory waste responsibly, and continuously reducing energy consumption.
We are a dynamic team of scientists and professionals who share a passion for innovation and discovery. We collaborate to push the boundaries of science.

En tant que partenaires de confiance des leaders de l'industrie pharmaceutique et des sciences de la vie, nous sommes animés par la passion d'améliorer la vie de la communauté mondiale.

Du développement de formulations aux tests analytiques, notre engagement envers l’excellence et l’innovation nous a valu une réputation de pionnier dans le domaine. Découvrez ce qui est possible et comment nous pouvons vous aider à rapprocher vos produits du marché.

blocks.label: Notre histoire
blocks.html:
Fondée en 1990, avec une vaste expertise combinée dans toutes nos activités, nous fournissons des solutions pour chaque étape du développement et de la commercialisation de produits. Notre portée et nos services se sont élargis grâce aux acquisitions d'Averica Discovery (États-Unis) et de MS Pharma, ainsi qu'au lancement de notre division Sciences de la vie. Intégré en une seule entité nous permet de mieux soutenir nos partenaires de l’industrie pharmaceutique.

Engagés envers les besoins analytiques de nos clients, nous fournissons des solutions fiables, rentables et innovantes.

Chez Neopharm, nous sommes fiers de fournir des solutions fiables, rentables et innovantes à nos clients. Notre équipe d’experts, dotée de formations scientifiques et de compétences techniques diverses, excelle dans la résolution de défis complexes avec précision et efficacité. Nous pensons que le succès de nos clients est notre mesure ultime et nous accordons la priorité à leurs besoins, défis et objectifs.

blocks.label: Notre objectif
blocks.html:
Mission

Se joindre à nos partenaires des sciences de la vie pour assurer la qualité de leurs produits à l’aide de nos services analytiques éprouvés.

Vision

Nous visons à être la référence au Canada dans le domaine des services analytiques pour l’industrie des sciences de la vie. Tout en poursuivant cette vision, nous restons déterminés à maintenir notre position d’employeur de choix, à attirer les meilleurs talents et à favoriser une culture d’excellence et d’innovation.

Valeurs

À Neopharm, nous avons défini des attentes précises sur la façon dont nous pouvons soutenir nos clients et nos talents. Pour atteindre notre objectif, nous suivons six valeurs puissantes qui définissent notre entreprise et notre culture.

  • Centré sur le client : nos clients sont au centre de tout ce que nous faisons, nous fournissons des solutions sur mesure qui dépassent les attentes.
  • Qualité et fiabilité : Nous maintenons une culture axée sur la qualité et améliorons continuellement nos processus pour répondre aux normes réglementaires et aux attentes des clients.
  • Expertise & Innovation : Les connaissances et l’expertise de notre équipe sont le moteur de notre approche innovante, nous permettant d’aborder les défis scientifiques en toute confiance.
  • Esprit d’équipe : La collaboration et le travail d’équipe sont les piliers de notre succès, favorisant un environnement de confiance, de soutien et de réalisations partagées.
  • Rigueur et engagement : Nous adhérons aux normes d’excellence les plus élevées, garantissant exactitude, précision et dévouement dans tous les aspects de notre travail.
  • Bien-être et développement des talents : Nous accordons la priorité au bien-être et à l’épanouissement professionnel de nos talents, en créant un environnement de travail positif et épanouissant.

blocks.label: Nos services
blocks.html:
Neopharm Labs possède des installations de pointe au Canada.

Chez Neopharm Labs, nous proposons une suite complète de services qui couvrent chaque étape du cycle de vie du produit. Notre vaste gamme de solutions analytiques accélère le parcours du concept à la commercialisation. Grâce à notre capacité de production élevée, nous pouvons gérer des projets de différentes tailles et complexités sans compromettre la qualité ou les délais d'exécution. Cela permet à nos clients d’accélérer leurs processus de recherche et développement, de rationaliser leurs opérations et de commercialiser leurs produits plus rapidement.

blocks.label: Profil réglementaire
blocks.html:
Qualité et conformité
 

Nous nous engageons à maintenir le plus haut niveau de qualité et de conformité aux normes de l'industrie. Nos laboratoires sont équipés d'une infrastructure informatique de pointe et d'une vaste gamme d'équipements améliorés pour garantir le plus haut niveau de diversité et de qualité des tests. Nous adhérons aux normes réglementaires, y compris l'intégrité des données, et nous sommes :

  • Sous licence de la Direction générale des produits de santé et des aliments (DGPSA) de Santé Canada
  • Enregistré et inspecté par la U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
  • Licence de drogues et substances contrôlées
  • Licence visant un précurseur de catégorie A
  • Licence de cannabis
  • Audité et qualifié par de nombreuses organisations pharmaceutiques mondiales

blocks.label: Développement durable et responsabilité sociale :
blocks.html:
Définis par l'excellence et l'inclusion

Avec un engagement profond en faveur de la durabilité et de la responsabilité sociale. Nous contribuons aux progrès de la médecine en accompagnant nos clients dans le développement et la commercialisation de nouveaux traitements, notamment des produits biologiques et des vaccins. Nous favorisons la diversité et l’égalité des chances, reconnaissant les précieuses contributions des femmes et des employés issus de divers horizons. Nous nous efforçons de minimiser notre impact environnemental en mettant en œuvre des pratiques respectueuses de l'environnement, en gérant les déchets de laboratoire de manière responsable et en réduisant continuellement notre consommation d'énergie.
Nous sommes une équipe dynamique de scientifiques et de professionnels qui partagent une passion pour l'innovation et l'excellence. Nous collaborons pour repousser les limites de la science.

General

  1. Unless otherwise agreed to under the terms of a separate written agreement, all offers for services and all resulting contractual relationship(s) between Neopharm Labs Inc. or any of its agents (the “Company”) and any person or entity issuing instructions to the Company (a “Client”), shall be governed by these General Conditions of Service.

The Quotation is an estimated cost provided in writing by the Company to the Client for services.
  3. Unless the Company receives prior written instructions to the contrary from Client, no other party is entitled to give instructions, particularly on the scope of the services, or the delivery of reports or certificates resulting therefrom (the “Reports”).

Provision of Services

  1. The Company will provide services using reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the Client's specific, complete, and unambiguous instructions (the “Instructions”) as confirmed by the Company, or, in the absence of such Instructions:
    1. The terms of any standard order form, specification sheet, or requisition form of the Company; and /or;
    2. Any relevant trade custom, usage, or practice; and/or;
    3. Such methods as the Company shall consider appropriate based on the circumstances of the service being rendered, including but not limited to technical, scientific, operational, regulatory, compliance, and/or financial grounds.
  2. The information contained in the Reports is derived from the results of inspection or testing procedures carried out with the Instructions of the Client, and/or the Company's assessment of such results on the basis of any technical standards, trade custom or practice, regulatory or compliance standards, and/or other factors which should be taken into account in the circumstances in the Company's opinion.
  3. Reports from the testing of samples contain the Company's opinion on those samples only and do not express any opinion on the lot from which the samples were drawn. d) The Reports issued by the Company reflect the facts recorded by it at the time of performing the services only and within the limits of the Instructions received, or, in the absence of such Instructions, as described in section 2 (a) (i) to (iii) above. The Company is under no obligation to refer to or report upon any facts or circumstances which are outside of the Instructions received.
  4. The Company may delegate the performance of all or a part of the services to an agent or subcontractor with the prior written authorization of Client.
  5. Client acknowledges and agrees that by providing the services, Company neither takes the place of the Client or any third party, nor releases them from any of their obligations, nor otherwise assumes or undertakes to discharge any duty of Client to any third party or that of any third party to Client.
  6. All samples will be retained for 30 days and then destroyed or returned to Client. Client may be billed for special handling, shipping, disposal, or storage charges.

Obligations of Client

  1. The Client will ensure that sufficient information, Instructions, and documents are given in due time to enable the services to be performed. The Client shall provide with each sample a unique purchase order, reference, Quotation, or authorization with sufficient detail to allow the Company to identify each sample and relate it to a specific Quotation or purchase order and the Company shall be entitled to rely upon such Quotation or purchase order to carry out the service.
  2. The Client shall supply all required Information about each sample and/or service requirement in order to assist Company to provide an efficient service. Where Information is incomplete, the Company reserves the right to charge for any additional work required.
  3. The Client shall be bound to inform the Company in writing prior to the Company carrying out any service on a sample that is of a dangerous or unstable nature and provide instructions on the safe handling of the sample. The Client shall indemnify the Company from and against all losses suffered by the Company, including, without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing, all damage to the Company's property and all claims in respect of injury to or deaths of any of the Company's employees, subcontractors or agents or of any third party, directly or indirectly arising from or in connection with the failure of the Client to inform the Company of the dangerous or unstable nature of a sample and/or to provide adequate instruction on the safe handling of the sample.

Fees and Payment

  1. Fees shall be at the Company's rates in effect (which are subject to change without notice) unless otherwise established in a Quotation, Master Service Agreement, or other written agreement. In the event that Company submits a Quotation without first receiving and reviewing applicable test protocols, any pricing submitted may be submit to change upon protocols being made available to Company. All applicable taxes shall be payable by Client.
  2. Fees shall be paid to the Company in full, in cleared funds, without any deduction, set-off or counterclaim within thirty (30) days of the date of the Company's invoice. Client shall not be entitled to retain or to defer payment of any sums on account of any dispute which it may allege against the company.
  3. In the event of any unforeseen expenses, problems, or additional work that arise in the course of performing the services, the Company shall endeavor to inform the Client and shall be entitled to charge additional fees for the time and costs to complete the services.
  4. Time of payment is of the essence. Without prejudice to section 5 below, in default of payment within the specified timelines, the Company may: suspend any services being carried out for the Client; withhold the provision of Reports; alter or withdraw credit terms; and amend terms, prices or service levels. The amount outstanding from time to time shall bear interest (both before and after any judgment) at the rate of 18% per annum from the due date for payment until payment in full is made.
  5. If the Company is unable to perform all or part of the services for any cause whatsoever outside the Company's control including failure by Client to comply with any of its obligations provided for herein, the Company shall nevertheless be entitled to payment of: the amount of all non-refundable expenses incurred by the Company and a proportion of the fee equal to the proportion of the services actually carried out.

Suspension or Termination of Services

The Company shall be entitled to immediately and without liability either suspend or terminate provision of the services at its sole discretion, without prejudice to any other right or remedy available to the Company, in the event of: failure by the Client to comply with any of its obligations hereunder, and such failure is not remedied within 10 days that notice of such failure has been notified to Client; or any suspension of payment, arrangement with creditors, bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership or actual or threatened cessation of business by Client. Upon termination of the services, any indebtedness of the Client to the Company shall become immediately due and payable.

Liability, Indemnification, and Release

  1. Limitation of Liability:
    1. The company is neither an insurer nor a guarantor and disclaims all liability in such capacity. Clients seeking a guarantee against loss or damage should obtain appropriate insurance.
    2. The Company shall not be liable to the Client whether in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty or otherwise for any loss of profit, loss of business, loss of market, loss of contract, damage to goodwill, loss of anticipated savings, loss of revenue, loss or damage incurred as a result of third party claims or any indirect or consequential loss howsoever caused.
    3. The company shall not be liable for any delayed, partial or total non-performance of the services arising directly of indirectly from any event outside the Company's control including failure by Client to comply with any of its obligations hereunder.
    4. The liability of the Company in respect of any claim for loss, damage or expense of any nature whatsoever and howsoever arising shall in no circumstances exceed the amount of the fee paid in respect of the specific portion of the service which gives rise to such claim.
    5. The company shall have no liability for any indirect or consequential loss including without limitation loss of profits, loss of business, loss of opportunity, loss of goodwill and cost of product recall. The Company shall further have no liability for any loss, damage or expense arising from the claims of any third party (including, without limitation, product liability claims) that may be incurred by the Client.
    6. In the event of any claim, Client must give written notice to the Company within 30 days of discovery of the facts alleged to justify such claim and, in any case, the Company shall be discharged from all liability for all claims for loss, damage or expense unless suit is brought within one year from: The date of performance by the Company of the service which gives rise to the claim; or the date when the service should have been completed in the event of any alleged non-performance.
  2. Indemnification: Client shall guarantee, hold harmless and indemnify the Company and its officers, directors, employees, affiliates, agents or subcontractors against all claims (actual or threatened) by any third party for loss, damage or expense of whatsoever nature including all legal expenses and related costs and howsoever arising relating to the performance, purported performance or non-performance, of any services. Without prejudice to the above, Client agrees to indemnify, keep indemnified and hold harmless the Company and its officers, directors, employees, affiliates, agents or subcontractors from and against all losses which the Client may suffer or incur arising out of:
    1. any breach or negligent performance or failure in performance by the Client of the terms hereunder;
    2. any breach of any law by the Client or the Company in connection with the performance of the Services; or
    3. any claim threatened or made against the Company by any third party arising out of the services or out of any delay in performing or failure to perform the services (even if such claim is solely or partly attributable to the fault or negligence of the Company).
  3. Release: To the extent permitted by law, Client waives and releases Company and its officers, directors, employees, affiliates, agents or subcontractors from all liability, claims, demands, actions, or causes of action for any alleged loss, damage, or injury, other than a claim for compensation pursuant to section 6 (a) (iv). This release covers all claims arising in contract or tort as well as arising under any federal, provincial, or state statute that in any way arise out of, or relate to, the services or performance or alleged non-performance under any agreement between the Parties.

Miscellaneous

  1. If any one or more provisions of these General Conditions of Service are found to be illegal or unenforceable in any respect, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not in any way be affected or impaired thereby.
  2. During the course of providing the services and for a period of one year thereafter Client shall not directly or indirectly entice, encourage or make any offer to Company's employees to leave their employment with the Company.
  3. Use of the Company's corporate name or registered marks for advertising purposes is not permitted without the Company's prior written authorisation.
  4. Company undertakes research projects and activities to overcome unanticipated or unavoidable technical and other challenges that occur in the course of performing services. Company may apply to government agencies for fiscal allowances for permitted R&D activities. The experimental work performed by the Company may be referred to in an anonymous form (i.e., without Client identity or Client proprietary information) to support Company's claims for such allowances.

Governing Law, Jurisdiction and Dispute Resolution

  1. The relationship between the Parties hereunder shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Quebec (and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein) and the Client submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Quebec, District of Montreal.
  2. The Parties hereto hereby acknowledge that they have required this document to be drawn up in the English language. Les Parties à Ia présente convention confirment qu'elles ont exigé que cette entente soit rédigée en langue anglaise.
